record.title: Beitbridge inbound commercial cargo blockade during duty protest, June–July 2018
record.scope: Inbound commercial cargo entering the Beitbridge border area from South Africa toward Zimbabwe
record.movement: Commercial cargo vehicles entering from South Africa; report does not establish total prohibition of all persons or vehicles.
record.imposing_authority: Protesting transporters and travelers; non-state physical blockade
record.enforcement: Report says travelers, many in private cars, deliberately blocked commercial cargo vehicles; security personnel intervened.
record.consequences: Vehicle queues and congestion reported; causal share attributable to blockade not quantified.
record.relationship: Incidental off-assignment discovery for South Africa/Zimbabwe 2018; not credited as completed search of that cell. Separate unresolved earlier June scanner-yard protest is R15-AS-L004.
record.status_observation: Contemporary report published 2018-07-02; no inference beyond reported episode.
record.official_rationale: No government closure order. Report attributes protesters’ action to Zimbabwe Revenue Authority enforcement of duties on specified imports.
record.context: The physical obstruction is distinguished from coincident customs congestion, staffing, computer-system and construction delays.
record.uncertainty: One Herald reporting lineage, including a reprint. Saturday preceding Monday 2 July 2018 is 30 June; exact onset of the physical blockade is not separately timed. Reported chaos until Sunday does not establish an exact reopening or continuous total closure.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation
